content: Network panel: P(ON) of every node through basal, E2 priming and differentiation with IL-1beta (default rules). Side panels: reference regimen and the two competing IL-1beta rules.
limitations: Model predictions, not observations. IL-1beta wiring is provisional. Time is dimensionless; node fill is a trajectory frequency, not a concentration.
main_result: Both IL-1beta rules abolish decidualisation; only the PGR-depletion rule also abolishes pSMAD1/5/8 (and, under the default Q2 relay, restores epithelial proliferation).
simulation: 10,000 trajectories, seed 1, unit rates, joint state carried across phases
